name: Complex Multi-Failure — Schema Drift + Data Loss + Null Violation
description: A complex failure scenario combining three issues: (1) a new column in source not in target, (2) a transformation step drops 15% of records due to a join with stale reference data, and (3) null values in a required field. The pipeline partially succeeds but with multiple data quality violations.
